k:幣.mnemonic: Strike (攵) grandmother's dusty towel (巾) and coins and notes tumble out of the folds: it was her hiding place for the housekeeping money. Cash (bad habit, humble prefix, gift).
k:幣.hint: Coins falling from a beaten towel.

k:悦.mnemonic: Elder brother (兄) is home from the sea at last. Your heartbeat (忄) leaps and you run down the pier shouting his name. Ecstasy (joy, rapture).

k:僅.mnemonic: The excellent (佳) honey from these mountain flowers (艹) is so rare that each mouth (口) gets just three (三) drops on the tongue. A wee bit.
k:僅.hint: Three drops of rare honey each.

k:軟.mnemonic: A car (車) with a lack (欠) of air in its tyres: press one and your thumb sinks right in. Soft.
k:軟.hint: Thumb sinking into a flat tyre.

k:紳.mnemonic: He gives a dainty (細) bend (曲) at the waist, one hand resting on his silk belt, and holds the door open for you. Sire (good belt, gentleman).
k:紳.hint: A neat bow and a held door.

k:稽.mnemonic: The cook tastes the grain (禾) porridge. Is it delicious (旨)? His head begins to wobble (尤) slowly from side to side while he makes up his mind. Think (consider, thought, thinking).
k:稽.hint: Cook's head wobbling over the porridge.

k:蓋.mnemonic: A lid woven from flowers (艹) is set down on the dish (皿), and the food is gone (去) from the sight of every fly in the room. Cover (lid, flap).

k:宰.mnemonic: Under the kitchen roof (宀) one person decides how spicy (辛) every pot shall be, tasting each one and giving orders to all the cooks. Superintend (manager, rule, reign).

k:痕.mnemonic: Long after you have left the sickbed (疒), one stubborn (艮) spot stays on your skin to show where the pox was. Mark (foot print, point, spot).
k:痕.hint: The spot the illness left behind.

k:痴.mnemonic: Fever has sent everything he used to know (知) off to the sickbed (疒): he salts his tea and says good morning to the coat stand. Stupid (foolish).
k:痴.hint: Salting tea, greeting the coat stand.

k:膜.mnemonic: Leave warm milk on the sill at dusk (暮) every evening for a month (月): each morning a thin skin has formed across the top that lifts off in one piece. Membrane.
k:膜.hint: Thin skin lifting off the milk.

k:鐘.mnemonic: A juvenile (童) swings on the rope with his feet off the ground, and the great gold (金) dome in the tower booms out over the village. Bell (gong, chimes).
k:鐘.hint: Child swinging on the tower rope.

k:隷.mnemonic: A servant (隶) who must show (示) the samurai (士) his empty hands every night: he owns nothing, is paid nothing, and may never leave. Slave (servant, prisoner, criminal).

k:眉.mnemonic: A little flag (尸) flying above the eye (目): it shoots up when you are surprised and dips when you frown. Eyebrow.

k:遮.mnemonic: Flames (灬) race along the path (辶) until the firefighters drag a soaking canopy (广) across the way and cut them off. Intercept (interrupt, obstruct).
k:遮.hint: Wet canopy dragged across the fire's way.

k:謡.mnemonic: The actor does not simply say (言) his lines: with a hand hooked like a claw (爪) he draws each word out slowly, dry (干) and deep, as if from a pit (凵). Chant (song, noh chant, sing).
k:謡.hint: Words drawn out slow and deep.

k:刈.mnemonic: Two crossed stalks on the left, and on the right a short blade beside a long curved one, sweeping in to slice them off at the base. Reap (cut, clip, trim).

k:匂.mnemonic: A spoon (匕) of warm vanilla custard held under the hood of the cradle (勹): the baby sniffs twice and smiles before tasting any. Fragrant (stink, glow, insinuate).
k:匂.hint: Baby sniffing a spoon of custard.

k:胴.mnemonic: Arms wave and legs kick, but the middle of you stays the same (同) from month (月) to month, the solid block that everything else hangs from. Trunk (torso, hull, hub of wheel).
k:胴.hint: The solid middle everything hangs from.

k:偏.mnemonic: The leader (亻) keeps the tome (冊) of rules behind his door (戸) and reads out only the pages that favour his own side. Partial (side, left-side radical, inclining).
k:偏.hint: Only his side's pages are read.

k:班.mnemonic: The king (王) slices his army into small teams with a knife (刂), then puts a little king (王) in charge of each one. Squad (corps, unit, group).

k:嘆.mnemonic: So young (若), and already carrying such big (大) troubles. Grandmother shakes her head and lets out a long slow breath. Sigh (lament, moan, grieve).

k:湿.mnemonic: Weeks after the tsunami (氵), the floorboards still bend (曲) underfoot and the walls feel clammy when you touch them. Damp (wet, moist).

k:喚.mnemonic: Facing (向) the cradle (勹) where the new baby gets all the attention, big (大) brother stamps his legs (儿) and screams at the top of his voice. Yell (cry, call, scream).
k:喚.hint: Big brother screaming at the cradle.

k:喪.mnemonic: She left for the far side of Asia (亜) long ago. Her garment (衣) still hangs by the door, and you touch its sleeve each time you pass. Miss (mourning).
k:喪.hint: Her coat still hanging by the door.

k:粋.mnemonic: Out of ten (十) grains of rice (米) the chef throws away nine (九) and serves only the single finest one, alone on a black plate. Chic (style, purity, essence).
k:粋.hint: One perfect grain on a black plate.

k:遷.mnemonic: A big (大) cobra (已) slides along the path (辶) heading west (西), leaving its old skin and old hole behind for a new home. Transition (move, change, motion).

k:但.mnemonic: 'We march at dawn (旦),' says the leader (亻), and then he raises one finger: 'unless it rains.' There is always a condition. However (but).

k:辱.mnemonic: The fisherman boasts of his giant clam (辰). Someone takes a measurement (寸): it is thumb-sized. He turns red while the whole dock laughs. Embarrass (humiliate, shame).

k:凶.mnemonic: He digs a pit (凵), greases a slide (ノ) leading into it, and hides to wait. One drop (丶) of sweat falls as he rubs his hands together. Villain (evil, bad luck, disaster).
k:凶.hint: Rubbing his hands beside the trap.
